name: Hadarezer
summary: The son of Rehob and king of Zobah, who fought against David. David defeated him twice, and the kings who served him made peace with Israel.

key_moments.title: Defeated by David
key_moments.description: David defeated Hadarezer king of Zobah and the Syrians of Damascus who came to help him. He took the shields of gold from Hadarezer's servants to Jerusalem, and much brass from his cities.

key_moments.title: Defeated Again at Helam
key_moments.description: Hadarezer brought out the Syrians from beyond the river, and they came to Helam under his captain Shobach. David defeated them, and the kings who served Hadarezer made peace with Israel.
